verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows cubic offering a way to plug third-party or partner-built agent apps into its workflows, such as a marketplace, app directory or partner integration framework. Custom agents are in-house review rules defined by your own team. The MCP server works the other way round: it exposes cubic to your coding agent. Connecting a ChatGPT or Claude Code subscription only supplies models for local reviews. These are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows
